description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class 'Coocook::Controller::Item' with methods for managing unassigned purchase list items, including listing, assigning, converting, and updating offsets. It interacts with project-related models and handles web requests related to item management within a cooking or recipe application.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Item
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing item-related web actions in the Coocook application.

methods.name: unassigned
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to list unassigned ingredients, fetching related articles, units, and dishes, and preparing data for rendering.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Handles POST requests to assign unassigned ingredients to purchase lists within a transaction, based on form parameters.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Handles POST requests to convert an item to a different unit, then redirects to the purchase list edit page.

methods.name: update_offset
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the offset of an item, either by total or offset value, then redirects to the purchase list edit page.
